name: 败者食尘 / Loser Eat Dust
author: Codex
description: Records the initial state of every visited map node in the current act and lets you restart from any of them. Designed to coexist with Quick Restart mods. Single-player only; no BaseLib or PCK. v0.2.5 snapshots and restores SpireBank's cross-run balance together with each new node checkpoint.
